rules.title: Practical Python or operations proof
rules.explanation: Either demonstrated Python error handling or the accepted personal log triage competency qualifies.
rules.accessibilityLabel: Any one of two practical proof requirements.

rules.title: Cross-domain core breadth
rules.explanation: At least three of four core competencies must meet their required level.
rules.accessibilityLabel: Three of four core breadth requirements.

rules.title: Networking verification floor
rules.explanation: TCP and IP must have current verified application evidence and cannot be compensated by a high average.
rules.accessibilityLabel: Mandatory TCP and IP verified floor, currently below requirement.

rules.title: Weighted target readiness
rules.explanation: Known and unknown weighted attainment is compared with the profile threshold without converting unknown to zero.
rules.accessibilityLabel: Weighted readiness threshold of eighty percent.

rules.title: Target profile root
rules.explanation: Every root rule must qualify; visual grouping does not imply this requirement.
